thread:
ops-dave: Heads-up — we're seeing repeated ECC/Xid errors on GPU cards in dedicated-pool-usw2-3. 3 different hosts reported Xid 31 in the last hour. :rotating_light:
ops-dave: Errors look like: `NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:05:00): 31` and ECC count rising on card 2 of host-05. Kernel logs attached below.
ops-dave: Attaching quick logs: ```Mar 12 09:11:02 host-05 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:05:00): 31, pid=2034, hostbyte=0x8e, faultbyte=0x0
Mar 12 09:11:03 host-05 kernel: GPUERR: ECC single-bit corrected on card 2 (count +1)```
maria: Thanks Dave. Customer AcmeApps is on that pool (Dedicated, reserved). Any immediate user impact?
ops-dave: Their jobs fell back to other hosts automatically thanks to our instance drain policy. No data loss, but they're seeing occasional increased latency for real-time inferencing. We throttled new allocations to the pool.
emma-cs: I need to draft customer-facing comms. Proposal: short email + support ticket noting we detected GPU hardware degradation, we initiated node drain and replacement, we don't expect quality regression, but there may be transient latency increases. ETA for hardware swap?
sanjay: Hardware tech ops scheduled a RMA for host-05 and host-07 tomorrow 10:00 PT. We're swapping cards and running extended memtest overnight on the replacement blades.
kevin: Can we offer immediate mitigation for AcmeApps (Private/Dedicated)? E.g., pin to another pool in a different AZ or enable burst capacity from dedicated-pool-usw2-1?
ops-dave: Yes — I can move their allocation to dedicated-pool-usw2-1 now. That will add ~5–8ms tail latency on some configs but keeps availability.
emma-cs: Draft for AcmeApps (short): "We detected hardware-level GPU ECC/Xid errors affecting a subset of hosts in your dedicated capacity in us-west-2. We've proactively drained affected nodes and initiated hardware replacement. We've migrated your workloads to a healthy pool to avoid downtime; you may see brief increases in latency. RMA and validation are scheduled for tomorrow. We'll follow up when replacements are complete and provide the incident summary." Thoughts?
maria: That reads well. Add a line about support ticket and who to contact for questions (CS rep + ops oncall).
infra-helena: Also add that for Private deployments we'll provide an image/ops playbook for customers doing on-prem swaps if they request.
emma-cs: Updated line: "If you run a Private deployment, we can share the hardware validation playbook and logs."
deploy-bot: action=drain host=host-05 pool=dedicated-pool-usw2-3 user=ops-dave ts=1745123800
ops-dave: Drain completed for host-05. Reallocations finished at 1745123950. Monitoring KV/caching to avoid cold-start penalties.
sanjay: Running extended memtest on replacement card now; will report results by 1745200000.
emma-cs: I'll send the comms now and open a ticket (CS-4528). I'll include RMA ETA, mitigation taken, and contact info.
maria: Thanks. After RMA completes, let's schedule a short postmortem to capture any improvements to detection thresholds and automated routing. :+1:
ops-dave: Agree — propose adding a small automation to alert when ECC single-bit count increases >50 within 1h per card so we catch flaky cards earlier.
kevin: SGTM. I'll add to infrastructure backlog.
emma-cs: Sending email in 5.
ops-dave: Closing thread for now — will update with RMA confirmation and test results.
